plugins.name: sleek
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to Sleek's remote MCP server (https://sleek.design/api/mcp) to create projects, design mobile app screens from a plain-language brief, and render them as images. Design runs spend your Sleek workspace's AI credits; sustained use requires a paid Sleek plan. MCP server only: no hooks, skills, agents, or commands.
